name: outline-trace
title: Outline Trace
description: Every glyph contour draws itself as a stroke, letter by letter, then the fill wipes up inside each letter and the stroke fades into it.
useWhen: A title should be drawn rather than revealed, like a trim path running around the real letterforms.
You want a crafted, vector-native entrance for a brand word or a headline.
An outline-only look is wanted: set Fill off and the drawn contours stay.
avoidWhen: The text should look handwritten, stroke by stroke in a script face: use handwrite.
The letters should fly in and deform rather than be drawn: use stretch-in.
The build should show the construction points and handles of a font editor: use glyph-anatomy.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word or short phrase. Letters, digits and . , ! ? ' - : & @ # $ % + / ( ) are drawn from built-in Inter ExtraBold outlines; other characters become spaces.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in reference pixels (1280×720 stage); long text shrinks to fit.

variables.label: Stroke width
variables.description: Width of the drawn contour in reference pixels.

variables.label: Fill
variables.description: Wipe a fill up inside each letter.

variables.label: Keep stroke
variables.description: Keep the stroke after the fill arrives.
